deco-lagoon.name: Deco Dragon (Lagoon)
deco-lagoon.why: Bam Bird Boutique's own Lagoon mat. Lagoon tiles on the Lagoon mat is blue on blue (your Oct 26 rule), so the Mulberry Dragon is in instead.

deco-lagoon.name: Deco Neoprene
deco-lagoon.why: The same lagoon teal as the backs, so the tiles disappear into it. It's in the Mulberry album.

deco-lagoon.name: Savannah
deco-lagoon.why: Forest green with olive, not teal, and no berry. It worked for Indigo, not for Lagoon.

deco-lagoon.name: The Speakeasy
deco-lagoon.why: Deco fans from the right era, but brick red and navy: the red fights her mulberry.

deco-lagoon.name: Art Deco
deco-lagoon.why: Black and white geometric. Right era, but no color to hold her.

deco-lagoon.name: Gatsby's Feathered Affair
deco-lagoon.why: An art deco fan, but sage and gray-green read dusty next to her jewel tones.

deco-lagoon.name: The Royal Deco
deco-lagoon.why: Cobalt and yellow: the name fits, the colors don't.

deco-lagoon.name: The Pastel Deco
deco-lagoon.why: Pastel pink and aqua: far too light for her.

deco-lagoon.name: Midori Shadows
deco-lagoon.why: Forest green, not teal, and no berry.

deco-lagoon.name: Emerald Cove Mat
deco-lagoon.why: Teal-green on teal: tonal, no second color. It's in the Mulberry album.

deco-lagoon.name: Jade
deco-lagoon.why: Blue-green with no berry: tonal on Lagoon. It's in the Mulberry album.

deco-lagoon.name: Peacock Garden
deco-lagoon.why: Navy and olive: no teal, no berry.

deco-lagoon.name: Ruby
deco-lagoon.why: A sage center and small florals: low contrast with her.

deco-lagoon.name: Delilah
deco-lagoon.why: Near the top of the color pull, but coral-red and bright turquoise: too bright for her deep jewel tones.

deco-lagoon.name: Penelope
deco-lagoon.why: Same story as Delilah: red and turquoise brights.

deco-lagoon.name: Neon Peacock Circle
deco-lagoon.why: Neon turquoise and hot pink: too bright for her.

deco-lagoon.name: Moody
deco-lagoon.why: A blue center, not teal, with a pastel floral border.

deco-lagoon.name: Grandmillennial Peony
deco-lagoon.why: Navy and coral peonies: close. A maybe for the next round if you want more.

deco-lagoon.name: East Meets West – Magenta
deco-lagoon.why: Solid hot magenta: brighter than her berry, and no teal.

deco-mulberry.name: Deco Dragon (Mulberry)
deco-mulberry.why: Bam Bird Boutique's own Mulberry mat. Mulberry on Mulberry, so the Lagoon Dragon is in instead.

deco-mulberry.name: East Meets West – Magenta
deco-mulberry.why: A brighter magenta than her backs, and no teal: berry on berry.

deco-mulberry.name: Brownstone Bloom
deco-mulberry.why: Rust and olive: warm and earthy next to her cool berry.

deco-mulberry.name: YOTD Plum
deco-mulberry.why: Violet, not berry, with lilac roses.

deco-mulberry.name: Mirage
deco-mulberry.why: Pink and red, warmer than her berry.

deco-mulberry.name: Plum Peony
deco-mulberry.why: Black and white florals; the plum is only in the props in the photo.

deco-mulberry.name: The Speakeasy
deco-mulberry.why: Brick red deco fans: they clash with her cool berry.

deco-mulberry.name: Allie (Purple)
deco-mulberry.why: Pale aqua and violet: too light for her.

deco-mulberry.name: Reba
deco-mulberry.why: The teal field works, but the bubblegum frame is lighter than her berry. A maybe.

deco-mulberry.name: Amethyst
deco-mulberry.why: Lilac and aqua peacocks: pretty, but too light.

deco-mulberry.name: Neon Daze Queen
deco-mulberry.why: Neon magenta: too loud next to her jewel tones.

deco-mulberry.name: Savannah
deco-mulberry.why: Forest green with olive: no teal, no berry.
